intro: From April 13 to May 15, 2026, ZCyberNews published seven articles under the palo-alto-networks tag. The most covered vulnerability was CVE-2026-0300, a critical flaw with a CVSS score of 9.3. Additional CVEs included CVE-2026-0246, CVE-2026-0248, and CVE-2026-0249. The coverage spanned a global impact, affecting sectors such as enterprise, government, technology, cloud services, and critical-infrastructure. The severity mix comprised two high, one medium, one critical, and one informational severity rating.
